dataset.name: RigRunsAI
notes: Model weight bytes are Hugging Face file sizes for a single GGUF, not estimates from bits-per-weight.
Architecture fields come from config.json, or from the GGUF header when the official config is access-gated.
Parameter counts are the gguf.total value on the Hugging Face model API for the cited GGUF repo.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
models.blurb: 1B dense instruct model. The architecture numbers are the GGUF header, because Meta's config.json is access-gated.
models.configNote: GGUF metadata: llama.block_count, embedding_length, head counts, key_length, context_length. Parameter count is gguf.total from the Hugging Face model API.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.blurb: 3B dense instruct model. Architecture from the public GGUF header.
models.configNote: GGUF metadata on the Q4_K_M file. Meta's config.json is access-gated.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
models.blurb: 8B dense instruct model and the usual baseline for a gaming PC.
models.configNote: GGUF metadata. head_dim is embedding_length / head_count (4096 / 32). Meta's config.json is access-gated.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
models.blurb: 70B dense instruct model. Only the single-file Q4_K_M size is listed; larger quants were split archives.
models.configNote: GGUF metadata. Meta's config.json is access-gated.

models.name: Qwen2.5 7B Instruct
models.blurb: Dense Qwen2.5 instruct model. use_sliding_window is false in config.json, so every layer keeps a full KV cache.
models.configNote: Official config.json. head_dim = hidden_size / num_attention_heads.

models.name: Qwen2.5 14B Instruct
models.blurb: Dense Qwen2.5 instruct model. use_sliding_window is false in config.json, so every layer keeps a full KV cache.
models.configNote: Official config.json. head_dim = hidden_size / num_attention_heads.

models.name: Qwen2.5 32B Instruct
models.blurb: Dense Qwen2.5 instruct model. use_sliding_window is false in config.json, so every layer keeps a full KV cache.
models.configNote: Official config.json. head_dim = hidden_size / num_attention_heads.

models.name: Qwen2.5 72B Instruct
models.blurb: Dense 72B instruct model. The Hugging Face license field is other. Only the single-file Q4_K_M size is listed.
models.configNote: Official config.json. head_dim = hidden_size / num_attention_heads.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.blurb: Dense Qwen3 model with a 40,960-token context. Sliding window is off in config.json.
models.configNote: Official config.json, including head_dim.

models.name: Qwen3 14B
models.blurb: Dense Qwen3 model with a 40,960-token context. Sliding window is off in config.json.
models.configNote: Official config.json, including head_dim.

models.name: Qwen3 32B
models.blurb: Dense Qwen3 model with a 40,960-token context. Sliding window is off in config.json.
models.configNote: Official config.json, including head_dim.

models.name: Qwen3 30B-A3B
models.blurb: Mixture-of-experts Qwen3. All 48 layers are sparse (decoder_sparse_step 1) with 8 of 128 experts active.
models.configNote: Official config.json: num_experts 128, num_experts_per_tok 8, moe_intermediate_size 768. No shared expert field.

models.name: Qwen3.5 9B
models.blurb: Hybrid model: 24 linear-attention layers and 8 full-attention layers. The GGUF used here is the language-model file.
models.configNote: text_config.layer_types, head_dim 256, linear_* fields, mamba_ssm_dtype float32.

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B
models.blurb: Hybrid 27B model: 48 linear-attention layers and 16 full-attention layers. Recommended file is Unsloth UD-Q4_K_M.
models.configNote: text_config layer_types and linear attention dims. No verified Ollama tag for this exact revision.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
models.blurb: Hybrid MoE: 256 experts, 8 active, plus a shared expert. 30 layers are linear attention and 10 are full attention.
models.configNote: text_config num_experts 256, num_experts_per_tok 8, shared_expert_intermediate_size 512, moe_intermediate_size 512.

models.name: Gemma 3 4B Instruct
models.blurb: Sliding-window model. Config sliding_window_pattern is 6, so every 6th layer is full attention and the rest keep a 1,024-token window.
models.configNote: Google's config.json is gated. Fields were read from the public unsloth config and checked against the bartowski GGUF header (block_count, heads, key_length, sliding_window).

models.name: Gemma 3 12B Instruct
models.blurb: Sliding-window model. Config sliding_window_pattern is 6, so every 6th layer is full attention and the rest keep a 1,024-token window.
models.configNote: Google's config.json is gated. Fields were read from the public unsloth config and checked against the bartowski GGUF header (block_count, heads, key_length, sliding_window).

models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.blurb: Small Gemma 4 model. 28 sliding layers (window 512) and 7 full layers. Sliding layers use head_dim and num_key_value_heads. Full layers use global_head_dim. When num_global_key_value_heads is null, full layers keep num_key_value_heads.
models.configNote: Official text_config: layer_types, sliding_window, head_dim, global_head_dim, num_key_value_heads, num_global_key_value_heads.

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.blurb: Gemma 4 model sized for laptops and handhelds. 35 sliding layers (window 512) and 7 full layers. Sliding layers use head_dim and num_key_value_heads. Full layers use global_head_dim. When num_global_key_value_heads is null, full layers keep num_key_value_heads.
models.configNote: Official text_config: layer_types, sliding_window, head_dim, global_head_dim, num_key_value_heads, num_global_key_value_heads.

models.name: Gemma 4 12B
models.blurb: Dense Gemma 4 12B. 40 sliding layers (window 1,024) and 8 full layers with global_head_dim 512 and 1 global KV head. Sliding layers use head_dim and num_key_value_heads. Full layers use global_head_dim. When num_global_key_value_heads is null, full layers keep num_key_value_heads.
models.configNote: Official text_config: layer_types, sliding_window, head_dim, global_head_dim, num_key_value_heads, num_global_key_value_heads.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B
models.blurb: MoE Gemma 4. config top_k_experts is 8 of num_experts 128, moe_intermediate_size 704. 25 sliding layers and 5 full layers.
models.configNote: Official text_config: layer_types, sliding_window, head_dim, global_head_dim, num_key_value_heads, num_global_key_value_heads.

models.name: Gemma 4 31B
models.blurb: Dense Gemma 4 31B. 50 sliding layers (window 1,024) and 10 full layers.
models.configNote: Official text_config: layer_types, sliding_window, head_dim, global_head_dim, num_key_value_heads, num_global_key_value_heads.

models.name: gpt-oss-20b
models.blurb: Open-weight reasoning MoE. The published GGUF is MXFP4, not Q4_K_M. 4 of 32 experts run each token. Half the layers use a 128-token sliding window.
models.configNote: num_local_experts 32, num_experts_per_tok 4, intermediate_size 2880, sliding_window 128, layer_types.

models.name: gpt-oss-120b
models.blurb: Larger gpt-oss MoE. MXFP4 file. 4 of 128 experts run each token.
models.configNote: num_local_experts 128, num_experts_per_tok 4, sliding_window 128.

models.name: Phi-4
models.blurb: Dense 14B-class Phi-4. head_dim is hidden_size / num_attention_heads from config.json (5120 / 40).
models.configNote: Official config.json. Context 16,384.

models.name: Phi-4-mini Instruct
models.blurb: Small Phi-4. The config sliding_window is 262,144, larger than the 131,072 context, so the KV estimate treats every layer as full attention.
models.configNote: Official config.json. head_dim = 3072 / 24.

models.name: Mistral Nemo 12B Instruct
models.blurb: Dense 12B Mistral. Context used here is config max_position_embeddings, 131,072.
models.configNote: Official config.json head_dim 128. The GGUF header context field is larger; this site uses the config value.

models.name: Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct
models.blurb: Dense 24B Mistral Small 3.2 (2506). Ollama's mistral-small:24b tag is labeled 2501, so this page does not show an Ollama command.
models.configNote: text/llm config hidden 5120, 40 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128.

models.name: Devstral Small 2 24B Instruct
models.blurb: Mistral's 24B coding model (2512), 40 dense layers, context 393,216. Ollama's devstral:24b tag is the earlier 2505 build, so no command is shown.
models.configNote: Official config max_position_embeddings 393216, head_dim 128, 40 layers.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 14B
models.blurb: Reasoning distill on the Qwen2.5 14B architecture. use_sliding_window is false.
models.configNote: Official config.json, Qwen2 architecture.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 32B
models.blurb: Reasoning distill on the Qwen2.5 32B architecture.
models.configNote: Official config.json.

models.name: SmolLM3 3B
models.blurb: Dense 3B model from Hugging Face. All 36 layers are full attention. No Ollama library tag was found for SmolLM3.
models.configNote: Official config.json. head_dim = 2048 / 16.
